subject: DataTable doesn't work properly with matrixes

messages.author: 2de7c33d05dd213b
messages.subject: DataTable doesn't work properly with matrixes
parts:
When using DataTable to output a matrix it shows data correctly, but entering anything into filters, which are located under each column, yields an error:
Error in data[i, , drop = FALSE] : subscript out of bounds

Simple example:
output$tbl <- renderDataTable({
    df <- matrix(1:20,ncol=2)
    colnames(df) <- c('a','b')
    df
})
